subject: MAP draft & pricing — exec review needed for credit/commit decision
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Erin Lopez <erin@finlytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft (v2) — next steps

Thanks again for your time earlier today — quick recap and the MAP draft attached (Finlytics_MAP_v2.xlsx). Highlights and asks: 

- Target close: 2026-08-27 (you flagged procurement runway of ~3–4 weeks).
- Proposed milestones (MAP v2):
  * Week 0: Pilot access & integration (Finlytics eng, Redwood infra) — target Aug 9
  * Week 2: Pilot evaluation & OKR alignment — target Aug 23
  * Week 3: Procurement & legal signoff — target Aug 27
  * Week 4: Production enablement & support handoff — target Sep 3
- Responsibilities:
  * Finlytics: pilot data slice, security questionnaire, procurement contact
  * Redwood: MAP ownership, implementation runbook, SOW & pricing
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, SLA language for data residency, and a committed tier for predictable capacity if you need guaranteed latency during pilot.

Two asks from your side: 
1) Please confirm the procurement contact (I noted procurement@finlytics.com) and whether they need a separate security packet.
2) Confirm whether your procurement team will require a one-time onboarding credit or a discount against committed spend (tells us which approval path to route).

I attached the MAP (xlsx) and a preliminary SOW (SOW_Redwood_v0.3.pdf) for callouts. If the credit/commit question requires exec approval, please indicate so — I will route an approval request internally.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Finlytics_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Redwood_v0.3.pdf (PDF)
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Lopez <erin@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & MAP draft (v2) — next steps

Thanks, Marissa — good recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement wants a clear commitment/discount profile. They asked: would Redwood consider a one-time onboarding credit (we suggested 15% of first-year committed spend) or a reduced per-token price for the first 6 months?
- Our security lead flagged data residency and SLA penalties for downtime >300ms as blockers — they want the SOC2 artifacts and draft SLA language.
- Target close: we are aiming for Aug 27 if procurement and legal get what they need; otherwise could slide into mid-September.

For clarity: our preferred path is a 12–month committed tier, but if Redwood requires a higher commit to offer a deeper credit we can consider a 24-month option. Please propose what your team can authorize without exec signoff vs what needs escalation.

On the MAP milestones: we can own the pilot data slice and provide a named procurement contact once legal confirms SLA language.

--
Raj
Senior Product Ops | Finlytics
raj.patel@finlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Finlytics MAP draft & credit ask — need exec pricing route

Forwarding the thread — Finlytics is asking for either a 15% one-time onboarding credit or a reduced rate for the first 6 months. They prefer a 12-month commit but may go 24 months for deeper concessions. Procurement also needs SOC2 evidence and SLA language.

Quick financials/context: 
- ARR opportunity (1st-year total): ~$425k estimated at the proposed committed tier.
- 15% on first-year committed spend ≈ $63.7k — asks to be applied as a credit to invoices or as PS credit.

My recommendation: offer a 10% one-time onboarding credit + $25k professional services credit if we require only 12 months committed. If they sign 24 months we can consider a larger credit (to be decided here).

Asks for you both: 
1) Can finance/legal approve 10% + $25k PS credit without VP signoff? If not, we need to escalate.
2) If we need to escalate, what format is best for exec review (one-pager + forecast impact + MAP summary)? I can prepare the note — need a decision by COB 2026-08-04 to keep their Aug 27 close target.

Attachments: Finlytics_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_Redwood_v0.3.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Finlytics MAP draft & credit ask — need exec pricing route

Marissa — thanks for the forward and the recommendation. Quick thoughts: 

- I'm comfortable with the 10% onboarding credit + $25k PS credit for a 12-month committed tier as our baseline 'authorized' concession for AE level. That keeps us within an acceptable LTV impact and preserves flexibility. 
- If Finlytics pushes for 15% or a larger up-front discount, we should require a written business case and route to VP Sales for approval (Jonas or Markus depending on region/account owner).
- Suggest tying the credit to measurable milestones in the MAP (credit applied after successful pilot + procurement signoff) to reduce risk.
- For SLA/data residency asks: confirm with Product/Compliance the exact wording. Legal will need to review any penalty language — loop Legal early.

I'll approve up to the 10% + $25k PS credit. Neha — do you need a finance doc to sign off or is this okay to rubber-stamp? If you need it, Marissa, please prepare a one-pager with net present value impact and what's being traded (commit length / MRR uplifts).

Ben
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Finlytics MAP draft & credit ask — need exec pricing route

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers. Conditional approval from Finance: we can support a 10% one-time onboarding credit plus a $20k professional services credit for a 12-month committed contract. Conditions: 

- Credit applied after pilot success and procurement/legal signoff (matches Ben's milestone idea).
- Commit must be for a minimum of 12 months at the agreed committed tier and include quarterly QBRs.
- Any credit >$20k or >10% requires VP Sales approval.
- Finance needs a simple P&L impact note (one-pager) showing first-year revenue, gross margin impact, and payback within 18 months. Marissa — please prepare and route by EOD so I can sign.

I'll also ask Legal to standby for SLA language. If Jonas (VP Sales) needs to be looped, please include a short exec summary and the MAP milestones.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
